_comment: DEV environment NON-SECRET parameters only (specs.md §15). postgresAdminPassword is @secure() and is NOT here and never will be: it is supplied at deploy time from the GitHub secret PGADMIN_PASSWORD_DEV via -p postgresAdminPassword=... It MUST be a different value from production's PGADMIN_PASSWORD — a dev credential leak must not reach production. Image tags default to the public mcr.microsoft.com/k8se/quickstart placeholder for the one-time bootstrap deploy and are overridden by CD with the real ACR images (todo-api:<sha> / todo-web:<sha>-dev); for that bootstrap deploy also pass -p containerTargetPort=80, because the placeholder listens on 80 while the real images listen on 8080. postgresLocation and postgresServerName are pinned to centralus / pg-todo-demo-dev-cus01 because Postgres location and name are immutable after creation AND because this subscription has a Postgres Flexible Server offer restriction in East US (the same restriction that put production in Central US). The postgresEntraAdmin* values are NON-SECRET identity metadata (an object ID and a UPN are not credentials) and are deliberately the SAME HUMAN admin as production's: reusing the human admin across servers is correct, reusing an application identity across servers is forbidden. acrName and logAnalyticsName name resources that already exist and are SHARED with production; this template references them as `existing` and creates neither.
